### CVE-2016-1909
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2016-01-15 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 43386: Fortinet FortiGate 4.x < 5.0.7 - SSH Backdoor Access (remote/linux, 2016-01-09, verified=0)

Fortinet FortiAnalyzer before 5.0.12 and 5.2.x before 5.2.5; FortiSwitch 3.3.x before 3.3.3; FortiCache 3.0.x before 3.0.8; and FortiOS 4.1.x before 4.1.11, 4.2.x before 4.2.16, 4.3.x before 4.3.17 and 5.0.x before 5.0.8 have a hardcoded passphrase for the Fortimanager_Access account, which allows remote attackers to obtain administrative access via an SSH session.

Affected:

### CVE-2016-6909
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2016-08-24 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 40276: Fortigate Firewalls - 'EGREGIOUSBLUNDER' Remote Code Execution (webapps/hardware, 2016-08-19, verified=0)

Buffer overflow in the Cookie parser in Fortinet FortiOS 4.x before 4.1.11, 4.2.x before 4.2.13, and 4.3.x before 4.3.9 and FortiSwitch before 3.4.3 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTTP request, aka EGREGIOUSBLUNDER.
